common-v2__webView_quiz_bb_tamil_s8_FAQ_:
a. Bigg Boss Fan Zone is a new Polling interactivity created for Bigg Boss fans. This adds an engaging and interactive dimension to your beloved show by allowing viewers to express their opinions on various topics, with the results of some of these polls may directly influence the show's content.
b. All logged-in viewers above the age of 18 can participate in the 'Bigg Boss Fan Zone' poll.
c. Viewers are allowed to take part in the 'Bigg Boss Fan Zone' poll once per account every day.
d. 'Bigg Boss Fan Zone' Poll relating to Bigg Boss Tamil Season 8 will run till 29th December 2024
What is 'Bigg Boss Fan Zone' and who can participate in it?

Viewers can answer two (2) questions everyday in the 'Bigg Boss Fan Zone' Poll. Each question is opinion-based, allowing viewers to express their viewpoints. One (1) question will be a weekly question which will remain the same and be available from Monday to Friday and the other question will be a daily question which will be a unique question during each day of the Poll Period
What type of questions are in the 'Bigg Boss Fan Zone' Poll?

a. Viewers receive 20 points for each question answered.
b. Bonus points are earned for daily participation (10 points multiplied by the number of days played).
    Eg If the viewer participated in the poll for the 5th time in the season, then the viewer will get 50 bonus points on the 5th day of participation
c. Additional 100 points each day of the Poll are granted for sharing Poll results with friends.
How are points awarded in the Poll?

a. There are two types of leaderboards the Weekly leaderboard and the Season leaderboard.
    i. The Weekly leaderboard ranks viewers based on their points earned during a week, from poll participation and for sharing of poll results with friends (excluding bonus points). The week runs from Saturday to Friday.
    ii. The Season leaderboard ranks viewers based on their cumulative points earned from the beginning of the season until 29th December 2024. This includes points from poll participation, sharing of poll results with friends, and bonus points.
What are the different types of leaderboard?

In the event of a tie, the tiebreaker is determined by the higher watch time of Bigg Boss Tamil (any/all episodes of Bigg Boss Tamil Season 5,6,7,8 and 24x7 feed available on the Disney+ Hotstar Application) by the viewer participating through the participating profile, on the Disney+ Hotstar Application or any other operating systems/platforms on which Disney+ Hotstar is available (including connected televisions and tablets) or on the website www.hotstar.com/in. The specific criteria will vary for the Weekly and Season leaderboards
    i. For the Weekly leaderboard, watch time during the respective week serves as the tiebreaker.
